content: Roshni Yadav followed up with Suresh Deshmukh regarding her auto policy (AP-001234) still showing as 'Pending' despite submitting the vehicle inspection report, requesting it be updated to 'Active'. Suresh apologized for the delay, noted the report is still being processed, escalated the issue to the technical team, and promised to notify Roshni once the status changes to Active.

action_items: Technical team to process vehicle inspection report
Notify customer when policy status changes to Active
